title: The Burning Oath
author: R. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Yara Vasquez, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
